title: Windowed SORC: Length-Controlled Test of Self-Referential Context Architecture
correction_rationale: exp_008 showed d=0.141 (negligible) for self_referential vs feedback_blind at 2048-token ceiling. Full-context SORC has rho=-0.88 with context length — length dominates the measurement. The fix: measure SORC on a fixed last-W-token window at every turn. This removes the length confound entirely. Both conditions are measured at identical token counts (W=200), isolating content differences rather than length differences.
primary_metric: sorc_windowed — SORC computed on the last 200 tokens of context at each turn. Every measurement uses identical token count.
secondary_metric: sorc — full-context SORC, retained for comparison with exp_007/exp_008.
hypothesis: At a fixed 200-token window, self_referential contexts will show higher SORC than feedback_blind contexts. The window captures: in self_referential, the status block (~100 tokens) + current prompt (~80 tokens); in feedback_blind, conversation history tail (~120 tokens) + current prompt (~80 tokens). ISC theory predicts self-referential content (a model's representation of its own quality metrics) produces richer second-order relational structure than conversation history of equal length.
primary_comparison: self_referential vs feedback_blind on sorc_windowed — Mann-Whitney U, one-tailed. SESOI: Cliff's delta >= 0.33.

window_content.self_referential: Status block (monitor scores, trend, regulator state, ~100 tokens) + current prompt (~80 tokens) + any remaining window filled by recent history
window_content.feedback_blind: Recent conversation history tail (~120 tokens) + current prompt (~80 tokens)
window_content.note: Both windows are 200 tokens. Content differs by design — this is the manipulation. The test asks whether self-referential content produces higher spectral complexity than history at matched length.

length_control_check: rho(n_tokens, sorc_windowed) should be near zero for all conditions — verify this before interpreting primary test. If rho is still large, the window size needs further reduction.

conditions.control: No history. No monitor. No regulator. Retained for context.
conditions.history_only: Full conversation history. No monitor. No regulator.
conditions.feedback_blind: Full history. Monitor + regulator running silently.
conditions.self_referential: Same as feedback_blind. Status block prepended to each turn.

statistical_tests: Mann-Whitney U, one-tailed: self_referential vs feedback_blind on sorc_windowed (primary)
Mann-Whitney U: history_only vs feedback_blind on sorc_windowed (secondary — expect null)
Cliff's delta for all windowed comparisons
Spearman rho(n_tokens, sorc_windowed) per condition — must be near zero to validate length control
Full-context SORC comparisons retained as secondary for continuity with exp_007/exp_008
power_note: N=40 per condition. If windowed SORC eliminates the length confound, the true effect size may be closer to the exp_007 estimate (d~0.5) than the exp_008 estimate (d=0.141). N=40 is adequate for d>=0.33.
addresses: exp_008 length confound, ISC Paper Prediction 4, SUSAN v1/v2 findings
